fields.label: Sync manually marked watched items
fields.description: Also send items marked watched without being played, for every profile. Each profile can also turn this on for itself in Settings → Watch Providers. The existing-entry restriction applies to manual marks too.

fields.label: Full import rescan
fields.description: Turning this on rescans each connected account's whole AniList list once, on its next sync. Later syncs only read changes again. Turn it off and on to rescan again, or use Rescan on the AniList Sync page.

fields.label: Only update anime already on AniList
fields.description: Skip exports for anime absent from the connected account's list, for every profile. Each profile can also turn this on for itself. Add titles to Plan to Watch before watching. Reduces unwanted additions from false matches; does not filter Silo libraries or watched-history imports.

presentation.summary: Syncs anime watch progress and movie ratings with AniList through Silo's watch-provider pipeline.
presentation.description_markdown: Uses Silo's host-owned watch-sync pipeline for encrypted per-profile credentials, durable playback completion delivery, optional manual watched marks, retries, imports, and rich episode identity. Episode exports prefer the daily AniBridge v3 dataset, with an Anime-Lists and ARM fallback. Watch-history imports reverse-map AniList progress through AniBridge. Movie ratings sync both ways. AniList progress is monotonic and ambiguous mappings are rejected rather than guessed. An administrator page lists connected accounts, unmapped titles and recent problems.
presentation.setup_markdown: To connect a profile, open Settings → Watch Providers → AniList and select Connect. Silo shows a code and a button that opens the activation page; enter the code, approve access on AniList, and return to Silo. The connection completes automatically and shows your account. AniList tokens last about one year; when one expires, Silo asks you to reconnect. Administrators can check every connection on the AniList Sync page in the admin menu. For players that report a stop at zero, connect the optional AniList with Silo watched check provider instead, using an AniList access token, your Silo server URL, a Silo API key and the current Silo profile ID; see the README. Requires a Silo server from September 24, 2026 or later.
